name: Interfaz + cursor gigante + acercamiento
trend: Es la gramática dominante: 159 de las 260 referencias de Montaj son animación de interfaz, 55 usan acercamiento y 46 cursor. Ejemplos: Claude Code Security (26M), Grok App Builder (24M).
look: Ventana de app limpia sobre fondo neutro; un cursor sobredimensionado viaja, hace clic con onda y la cámara se acerca 1.2–1.3× al punto del clic; subtítulo en píldora abajo.

recipe.author: @jake11moran (NotchBrowser, HyperFrames)
recipe.text: Motion should feel slow and polished - one continuous camera over one Mac desktop, no hard cuts. Camera pushes, pulls and pans run like 1.5 to 3 seconds on gentle ease-in-out curves, nothing snappy - aim for half the speed you'd default to. Add motion blur on fast moves and a light film grain finish. Use an oversized macOS cursor.

recipe_notes: Montaj: cuando el cursor toca el botón, acercar 1.3×; en clic, el botón baja a 0.95× y regresa. Regla de make-awesome-video: nunca inventar UI; usar capturas reales o componentes reales.

recipe.text: It should feel like a cinematic essay, not a slideshow or a timeline infographic. … Before building, write STORYBOARD.md with each scene's timing, visuals, on-screen text and transitions. … After each scene, render 3–4 stills and look at them critically. … Accuracy matters: use correct years, names and paper titles.
